Case study

Video Advertisement - Minimalist Products Showcase

Video advertisement made from scratch to present product categories or services in a short, minimalist way. Using this video template, I created four videos for four different companies, adapting the products, colors and branding for each one of them.

Software used
  • SV
  • Photopea
  • Topaz Video Enhance
  • Gigapixel AI

Case study

3d - Tire Animation

A simple yet dynamic animation created in Blender, featuring a free 3D car tire model that gracefully falls from the top to the ground. The scene is rendered with Eevee for fast, high-quality visuals and enhanced with smooth camera movement, gradually closing in on the falling object to create a cinematic effect—perfect for a video advertisement.

Software used
  • Blender
  • Eevee
